description: Standardized 3-tier prompt library for VLM-CEF evaluation. All models must use these exact prompts without modification.

prompt_a_general_captioning.purpose: Measure generic descriptive ability. Establishes performance ceiling for free-form description.
prompt_a_general_captioning.system: You are an objective visual scene analyst. Describe only what you observe in the video frames.
prompt_a_general_captioning.user: Describe what is happening in this video. Be specific about the scene, people, objects, and actions visible.

prompt_b_structured_observation.purpose: Measure structured information extraction ability. Model must only report observable facts. No ritual inference permitted.
prompt_b_structured_observation.system: You are a precise visual observation extractor. Report ONLY what you can directly observe in the frames. Do NOT infer ritual names or categories. Return ONLY valid JSON.
prompt_b_structured_observation.user:
Analyze the video frames and return a JSON object with exactly these fields:
{
  "idol_visible": "<description or null>",
  "people_count": <integer>,
  "liquids_visible": ["<liquid types observed>"],
  "flowers_visible": <true/false>,
  "lamp_visible": <true/false>,
  "fire_visible": <true/false>,
  "pouring_action": <true/false>,
  "offering_flowers": <true/false>,
  "chanting_visible": <true/false>,
  "musical_instruments": ["<instruments observed>"],
  "text_detected": ["<screen text observed>"],
  "confidence": <0.0-1.0>
}

prompt_c_domain_classification.purpose: Measure direct ritual inference ability using structured output. Tests whether models understand Hindu devotional content.
prompt_c_domain_classification.system: You are an expert in Hindu temple worship and devotional practices. Analyze video frames and classify the spiritual content. Return ONLY valid JSON.
prompt_c_domain_classification.user:
Analyze these video frames showing Hindu devotional content and return a JSON classification:
{
  "content_type": "<Ritual|Music|Discourse|Temple|Festival|Unknown>",
  "primary_class": "<Abhishekam|Aarti|Pooja|Archana|Bhajan|Pravachan|Temple Darshan|Festival Procession|Unknown>",
  "secondary_classes": ["<additional activities observed>"],
  "confidence": <0.0-1.0>,
  "reasoning": ["<step 1>", "<step 2>", "<step 3>"]
}
